text:
Maya (People Ops): FYI new Eng Manager (Taylor) starts Mon 09:30 PT. Putting a concise manager onboarding checklist here so we don’t miss basics. Please confirm your bit by EOD Fri.

Maya (People Ops): Day-before checklist:
```
- Device shipped + labeled
- Okta + MFA invite sent
- Slack workspace & team channel added
- Email + calendar created
- Notion access: /team/eng/managers, hiring docs, OKRs
- 1Password manager vault access granted
- Welcome 1:1s pre-scheduled (dir, skip-level, team)
```

Lena (People Ops): I’ll send the welcome email with first-week expectations and link to the 1Password setup.

Sam (IT): Device ordered (MacBook Pro), imaged w/ dev profile. Will assign to Taylor’s name and drop tracking. Need group for cluster access - `eng-dev` or `eng-admin`?

Chris (Eng): Start with `eng-dev`. We can promote after 30d if needed.

Maya (People Ops): Access matrix (short):
- Payroll & comp questions: Lena
- Hardware & accounts: Sam
- Infra & cluster: Chris (platform@)
- Security/compliance training: eng-security channel + auto-training link

onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Taylor - prestart checklist" Fri 17:00 PT.

Chris (Eng): Proposed week 1 manager agenda (concise):
Mon: 09:30 intro w/ People Ops (15m), 10:00 team kickoff (30m), 15:00 1:1 w/ director (30m)
Tue: buddy shadow + infra walkthrough (60m), 14:00 product context w/ PM (30m)
Wed: 30/60/90 draft session w/ director + HR (45m)
Thu: hiring plan sync, team processes + sprint flow (60m)
Fri: skip-level intro, retro of week 1, okrs alignment (30m)

Maya (People Ops): Short 30/60/90 bullets we ask managers to draft:
- 30d: meet team, understand codebase & infra, ship an onboarding tweak (doc or small PR)
- 60d: lead a planning session, identify two process improvements, begin onboarding 1 direct report
- 90d: drive roadmap priorities for a sprint, own hiring plan & performance calibration input

Lena (People Ops): Also include required trainings in week 1: security basics, data handling, manager anti-bias training. I’ll queue them in LMS.

Chris (Eng): Can we add a 30m "team norms & expectations" with leads on Tue morning? Helps set performance cadence.

Maya (People Ops): Added. Quick note about manager ramp KPIs (for calibration): time-to-productivity signals, onboarding win delivered, hiring/mentorship actions started. Keep it pragmatic.

Sam (IT): :white_check_mark: Device imaged and queued. Will post tracking.

Chris (Eng): :white_check_mark: Team kickoff + buddy confirmed. I’ll bring a starter 30/60/90 template for Wed.

Lena (People Ops): :white_check_mark: Welcome email + trainings queued.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks everyone. I’ll publish the minimal manager onboarding doc to Notion and DM Taylor the week1 agenda + links. If anyone has other must-dos for managers, drop them here.

Chris (Eng): One last tiny ask 94 add the hiring bar rubric link to the welcome pack so they can review before meeting the recruiter.

Maya (People Ops): Done. Closing checklist once I see all :white_check_mark: reactions.

onboard-bot: Thread archived to new-hires and reminder cleared.
